en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a coastal Scandinavian town with many wooden houses clustered on rocky terrain. In the center stands a large stone church with a tall spire, and in the background are bare rocky islands and water channels. The word "SMÖGEN" is printed in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 22 appears in the lower right.
